summary: The New theme editor's panel ends 16 px above the status bar's top edge at 13 and 18 pt in Midnight and Porcelain, at rest, scrolled to its end and with a save error wrapped to two lines, which takes its room from the scrolling body, and a focused footer button (Save, Cancel, Reset to base) draws its focus ring whole inside the panel; the base ends the panel 16 px above the window, across the status bar, and a save error makes it taller
limitations: Linux X11 under XWayland at scale factor 1 with server decorations only: native Wayland with client decorations, the window_paddings case, was not exercised, because qa.py launches only X11 clients, and rests on the_cap_keeps_the_panel_inside_client_decorations; one window size, 1000 x 680; the footer buttons' focus is captured at rest only (with the save error it rests on a_focused_footer_buttons_ring_lies_inside_the_body_in_every_state); Edit theme, other window-capped dialogs and the Reflog's body_height are not captured; macOS and fractional scale factors are not covered

fixture.name: theme-editor-panel-bounds
fixture.description: three commits on main, a repository for the window to open; the evidence is on the Settings page and in the theme editor, which read and write only the launch's own app data
